title: Auto Win AFK Farm Ragebot Silent Aim ESP and More
features:
This script is part of Forge Hub, our free hub with dedicated scripts for a growing list of games. Everything is configurable in the menu and configs save automatically. Join the Discord for updates, support and new game releases: discord.gg/forgehubrbx

───────────────────────────────────────

Features (Duels Murderers vs Sheriffs):

RAGEBOT
- Silent Aim
- Auto Fire
- Instant Kill (optimizes for hvh)
- Weapon Choice 
- Auto Stab (Close)
- Auto Retarget
- Target Priority 
- Target Part 
- Wall Check
- FOV Circle (custom color, size)

ANTI AIM
- Anti Aim Modes (jitter, side step, spin, vertical, warp)
- Adjustable distance and tick rate
- Randomise
- Only in round

KILL ALL
- Kill All Key
- Auto Each Round

AIMBOT
- Aim Key (or Always On for mobile)
- Smoothing (adjustable)
- Target Switch Delay
- Target Part (head, upper body, or root)
- Wall Check
- FOV Circle (own color)

TRIGGER BOT
- Fires when your crosshair crosses an enemy
- Fire Delay (adjustable)
- Wall Check
- FOV Circle (own colour)

AUTO QUEUE
- Finds you a game automatically
- Game Mode (1v1, 2v2, 3v3, 4v4, FFA)
- Auto Requeue after every match

WIN FARM
- Farms wins on its own fully AFKable
- Win Limit
- Kill Delay

AUTO REMATCH
- Vote rematch or teleport back to the lobby

AUTO MAP VOTE
- Picks a map for you (random or a specific one)

CRYSTAL COLLECTOR
- Collects crystals around the map (instant or walk to)
- Delay

AUTO CLAIM
- FFA Challenge
- Return Challenge

AUTO CODES
- Redeem All

CRATE OPENER
- Opens crates on repeat (pick which crate)
- Keep Coins (threshold slider)
- Show Roll
- Open Delay

PLAYER ESP
- See players through walls
- Enemies Only
- Separate enemy and team colours
- Distance limit

INFO TAGS
- Name, distance and health above players

TRACERS
- Lines to every player (origin setting, own colour)

CROSSHAIR
- Custom crosshair with size and colour
- Spin (adjustable speed)

FULLBRIGHT
- Brightens the whole map (adjustable)

MATCH HUD
- Round, timer, scores and players alive, shown in the HUD

MOVEMENT
- Fly (adjustable speed)
- Infinite Jump

TELEPORT
- Teleport to any player
- TP Behind Them

INVENTORY VIEWER
- Look through anyone's inventory, sorted by value or rarity

SPECTATE
- Watch any player and keep following them through respawns

SERVER
- Rejoin
- Server Hop

MENU
- Menu Keybind
- Mobile menu toggle in the HUD
- Default config autosave
- Unload
